Saṁyojaniyasutta Things That Tighten Fetters

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Saṁyojaniye ca, bhikkhave, dhamme desessāmi saṁyojanañca. “Mendicants, I will teach you the things that tighten the fetters, and the fetter. Taṁ suṇātha. Listen …

Katame ca, bhikkhave, saṁyojaniyā dhammā, katamaṁ saṁyojanaṁ? What are the things that tighten the fetters? And what is the fetter?

Rūpaṁ, bhikkhave, saṁyojaniyo dhammo; Form is something that tightens the fetters. yo tattha chandarāgo, taṁ tattha saṁyojanaṁ. The desire and greed for it is the fetter.

Vedanā …pe… Feeling …

saññā … Perception …

saṅkhārā … Choices …

viññāṇaṁ saṁyojaniyo dhammo; Consciousness is something that tightens the fetters. yo tattha chandarāgo, taṁ tattha saṁyojanaṁ. The desire and greed for it is the fetter.

Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, saṁyojaniyā dhammā, idaṁ saṁyojanan”ti. These are called the things that tighten the fetters, and this is the fetter.”

Aṭṭhamaṁ.
